# powl_sequence_operator

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Represents an ordered POWL operator sequence with exact predecessor binding.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operator_id` | `string` | yes | Sequence operator identity. |
| `step_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of ordered steps. |
| `predecessor_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of predecessor bindings. |
